sql: SELECT TOP 10 sl.SEOTitle AS seoTitle, sl.SEODescription AS seoDescription, s.SEOUrl AS seoUrl, l.BlogNewsTitle AS title, b.BlogNewsCode AS blogNewsCode, b.BlogNewsId AS blogNewsId, CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(@lt, c.BlogNewsContent, CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) + @one) > CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) + @one THEN LEFT(SUBSTRING(c.BlogNewsContent, CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) + @one, CHARINDEX(@lt, c.BlogNewsContent, CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) + @one) - CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) - @one), @contentLength) END AS contentText FROM dbo.ZnodeBlogNews b INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal p ON p.PortalId = b.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeBlogNewsLocale l ON l.BlogNewsId = b.BlogNewsId AND l.LocaleId = @localeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEODetail s ON s.SEOCode = b.BlogNewsCode AND s.PortalId = b.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEOType st ON st.CMSSEOTypeId = s.CMSSEOTypeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEODetailLocale sl ON sl.CMSSEODetailId = s.CMSSEODetailId AND sl.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeBlogNewsContent c ON c.BlogNewsId = b.BlogNewsId AND c.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSContentPages cp ON cp.CMSContentPagesId = b.CMSContentPagesId WHERE p.StoreCode = @store AND b.BlogNewsType = @blogNewsType AND b.IsBlogNewsActive = @isActive AND st.Name = @seoType AND (b.ActivationDate IS NULL OR b.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (b.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR b.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND sl.SEOTitle IS NOT NULL AND (@withSeoDescription IS NULL OR sl.SEODescription IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishBlogNewsEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishBlogNewsEntity pe WHERE pe.BlogNewsId = b.BlogNewsId AND pe.PortalId = b.PortalId AND pe.LocaleId = @localeId AND pe.IsBlogNewsActive = @isActive) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT o.BlogNewsId FROM dbo.ZnodeBlogNews o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEODetail os ON os.SEOCode = o.BlogNewsCode AND os.PortalId = o.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEOType ost ON ost.CMSSEOTypeId = os.CMSSEOTypeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCMSSEODetailLocale osl ON osl.CMSSEODetailId = os.CMSSEODetailId AND osl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE o.PortalId = b.PortalId AND o.BlogNewsId <> b.BlogNewsId AND ost.Name = @seoType AND o.IsBlogNewsActive = @isActive AND (o.ActivationDate IS NULL OR o.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (o.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR o.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND CHARINDEX(sl.SEOTitle, osl.SEOTitle) > @zero) AND (@withContentText IS NULL OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(@lt, c.BlogNewsContent, CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) + @one) > CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) + @one THEN LEFT(SUBSTRING(c.BlogNewsContent, CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) + @one, CHARINDEX(@lt, c.BlogNewsContent, CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) + @one) - CHARINDEX(@gt, c.BlogNewsContent) - @one), @contentLength) END, @cr, @space), @lf, @space), @tab, @space), @nbsp, @space)))) > @zero) AND (@contentPageActive IS NULL OR cp.IsActive = @contentPageActive) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR sl.SEOTitle = @preferred) ORDER BY b.BlogNewsId
